control_implications.headline: Azure API Management (APIM) Classic tiers vulnerability exposes stolen API credentials
control_implications.significance: Exploitation of an Azure API Management Classic tier flaw to steal API credentials linked to energy sector attacks indicates cloud API credential storage risks. control_implications.headline: LaLiga data breach exposes personal information of users and affiliated clubs
control_implications.significance: LaLiga's disclosure of personal data exposure for users and affiliated clubs highlights risks in shared sports league platforms. The data protection owner should assess data sharing agreements with affiliates, verify encryption of personal data, and confirm breach response coordination.

control_implications.evidence_excerpt: Critical OT access devices will often tell you, and anyone else, whether they're protected by authentication — and many aren't.
control_implications.headline: Critical OT access devices broadcast insecure authentication status
control_implications.significance: Industrial serial gateways broadcasting their authentication status reveals widespread lack of basic access controls on OT devices. The access management owner should inventory all OT gateways, enforce authentication requirements, and implement network segmentation to limit exposure.

paragraphs.text: CISA's addition of actively exploited flaws to the KEV catalog underscores the urgency for vulnerability management across federal and contractor environments. Concurrent exploitation of ScreenConnect targeting MSP technicians, a legacy ASP.NET library, and Azure API Management Classic tiers demonstrates that supply chain remote access tools, outdated components, and cloud API surfaces are being weaponized. Control owners should prioritize asset inventory for these technologies, verify patching or compensating controls, and assess supplier access governance.

Confirmed data breaches at Korea Electric Power Corporation and LaLiga, combined with research showing industrial gateways broadcasting insecure authentication states, reveal persistent gaps in data protection and operational technology access management. The accountable owners should review network segmentation, data access logging, breach notification readiness, and OT device authentication enforcement to limit exposure of personal and sensitive data.
